en.3c9ac064: This medicine is used for fingernail, toenail, or hair growth disorders caused by biotin deficiency.
en.8114feec: This medicine is used for fingernail, toenail, or hair growth disorders caused by biotin deficiency.
en.4073a272: Take 1 tablet per 1 dose, 1 time a day, before a meal.
en.67234b85: Take 1 tablet per 1 day, 1 time a day, before a meal.
en.6bfa0f1b: Adults take 1 tablet per 1 dose, 1 time a day, before a meal.
en.cf97b383: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are an infant under 3 months of age, or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
en.4d122d3f: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are an infant under 3 months of age, or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
en.b8081805: Do not take this medicine together with raw eggs.
en.34420de2: Do not take this medicine together with raw eggs. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking this medicine together with carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital, or antibiotics.
en.22ead3e8: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are taking anticonvulsants such as carbamazepine, phenytoin, or phenobarbital, or antibiotics.

en.1a4da9aa: If hives or gastrointestinal disorders occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
